keyFindings.description: TMUX_OWN_GLOBALS[name] is a prototype-chain lookup: a table entry named constructor/toString/hasOwnProperty/valueOf/__proto__ is never unset. Object.hasOwn or a Set.
Session table is read before update-environment is emptied; an attach in that ms window survives until the next boot. Disable first.
show-environment error interpolates stdout (the value dump) when stderr is empty; no observed tmux 3.7c failure mode does that, but use stderr only, as fullMiseEnvironment does.
new-session and set-option update-environment '' are two client invocations; chain them (\;) so AGENTS.md's 'before anything can attach' is literally true.
ENVIRONMENT_ENTRY charset [A-Za-z0-9_%] silently skips legal names with - . / : (dashed bash functions, npm //registry:_authToken). Production table: 93/93 parsed, none skipped. Widen or document.

isSecretLikeName (second line of defence) misses *_KEY that is not _API_KEY (ENVOY_TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_KEY is in the production daemon env), *_CREDENTIALS, *_PASSWD, *_PAT, lowercase. Allow-list keeps paneEnv clean regardless; scrubGitHubCredentials in a pane relies on it alone.

jj child now inherits full process.env, but CodebaseIndexManager has no daemon caller (dead code). Delete the module or pass a minimal env; drop the AGENTS.md:167 'with the codebase index's jj log' clause.

'no kill-server is needed' is true for inheritance only. The running server process keeps its fork-time environ (/proc/2023008/environ on production still carries both App key names, readable by any same-uid process), as do pre-upgrade panes. Add: only kill-server or the key rotation (acceptance 5) revokes already-handed-out material. Same sentence for the PR body's Deployment step 2.
Garbled rule sentence; split in two.

deploymentNote: Production omp_launch_prefix already supplies OMP_PROFILE=legion and the three provider keys via secrets, so panes lose nothing they need. They do lose operator-shell extras they inherited by accident (ANTHROPIC_1M_CONTEXT, CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, MNEMOPI_*_WEIGHT, OPENCODE_GITHUB_REPO, BROWSER, MISE_SHELL, __MISE_*, npm_*): the pinned OMP build reads none of ANTHROPIC_1M_CONTEXT/CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS/OPENCODE_GITHUB_REPO; MNEMOPI_* and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR are read somewhere in the install — if wanted in panes they belong in omp_launch_prefix's env step, not the allow-list. The server process pid 2023008 and pre-upgrade panes keep the old key material until kill-server; rotation (acceptance 5) is the revocation.
